source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 2 同主题完形(新生第一周/感谢信/朋友助我成长/雨天/维系老友/一句善言)。用词限本单元/初高中常见词,4选项同词性,答案唯一无双解,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: A New Student's First Week

Sam even (6)____ me to his other classmates, who were all very (7)____ to me. That small act of (8)____ completely changed my week. passages.title: A Thank-You Letter
passages.text: Dear Anna, I am writing this letter to say a big thank-you. When I first arrived, I was a (1)____ student who knew no one at all. You were the first person to show me real (2)____. passages.title: A Rainy Day Turned Bright
passages.text: It was pouring with rain, and I had forgotten my (1)____. Standing at the school gate, I watched everyone hurry home and felt quite (2)____. passages.title: Keeping Old Friends Close
passages.text: Making new friends is exciting, but keeping old (1)____ is just as important. As we grow up, our busy lives can slowly (2)____ us apart. passages.title: The Power of a Kind Word
